## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue or feature motivation. Include relevant context and details about what was altered, added, or removed.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

Select all that apply:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, no API changes)
- [ ] CI/CD or build tooling change

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding and style guidelines.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run lint` and resolved all linter warnings.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run typecheck` and verified there are no TypeScript compilation errors.
- [ ] I have verified the production build with `npm run build`.
- [ ] I have tested changes across both light and dark themes (where applicable).
- [ ] I have tested responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the Conventional Commits specification.

## Screenshots / Previews (Optional)

If UI or visual layout changes are included, provide screenshots or short recording previews.
